affinity.notes: Near-black body and saturated violet portal effects strongly lock it to void or shadow.

anatomy.notes: Amorphous tentacles, eye clusters, and portal-like crown form a coherent aberrant body.

archetype.notes: Perceived role "zone controller" semantically communicates Unresolved-Ring Sovereign (Sovereign) or its battlefield duty.

finish.notes: Dense surface detail and controlled purple highlights feel production-ready.

framing.notes: Large silhouette is centered and fully legible against the pale ground.

identity.notes: Blind perception "many-eyed void aberration" semantically identifies void-horrors/void-horror-outer-sovereign.

tier.notes: Perceived tier "high" is accepted for intended T5 under the documented v2 normalization.
